svg.title: How Quantus solves an input: calculator mode and analysis mode
svg.text: Calculator mode: evaluate(…), from the typed LaTeX to the response. Every number stays exact until it is presented.
the store's settings, precision 1 … max, the session's variables
lexer → parser → AST; a label such as F = or v_1 = is split off
residual left − right at 0 and at each
unit vector, checked at more points;
a miss means not linear → error
exact on the augmented matrix [A | b],
a letter without subscript and value
evaluated exactly for each x; both sides need the same dimension
Fit a quadratic through f(0), f(1), f(2)
Does f equal ax² + bx + c
a = b = 0: every x, or none
point is sampled just beside it
each root simplified and presented; the first is the quantity
a letter without subscript or value
repeat while not in normal form
a decimal to precision p, or exact roots when set; a complex a + bi only in Imaginary mode, else error
SYMBOLIC → SUBSTITUTED (when session variables were put in) → STEP lines → RESULT, filtered by the step detail Brief … Maximal
A label with a subscript (v_1 = …) is stored as a session variable
analyze(…): one function, the whole curve sketch. Stateless, under a 3 s budget; past it the remaining sections come back as partial.
solve_zero: f(x) = 0 the way a student writes it
analysis/solve.rs · used by the highlighted sections
The first strategy that fits takes the equation; each step is a line of the working. Exact roots stay exact (√2, π/3 + k·π), numeric ones are rounded to the precision.
